subject: general
question:
Select the number from among the given alternatives that can replace the question mark (?) in the last figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7be61a1155193c8bd82bf398523aeae09eb6016cc9626a9ed1eb3fff06b13ff.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/63a271698701c4201cd770a184b6691ff67013e0003193bf0766c1ecc34ee29d.png] ⇒ 9 × 4 = 36

And,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/28d70344db31b50130c626769d8f11be2bdd10d6bc0575a13b0df82a5c273e48.png] ⇒ 8 × 7 = 56

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6fc228e2beac4463588003a3af5733e18c37791d644d1e67a866fdd6539db0d9.png] ⇒ 6 × 8 = 48

⇒ ? = 4 

Hence, "Option 1" is the correct answer.
